Oneliner

VHF uplink and UHF downlink linear transponder with a bandwidth of 30kHz.
Description

CAS-9 carries a VHF uplink and UHF downlink linear transponder with a bandwidth of 30kHz. This transponder will work all day during the life cycle of the satellite, and amateur radio enthusiasts around the world can use it for two-way radio relay communications.
